customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (content hash or seeded id)

company_name.meaning: registered legal name of the shipper, consignee or forwarder company exactly as on the commercial register

contact_name.meaning: full name of the registered primary contact person for the company profile

phone_number.meaning: registered contact phone number in E.164 form, e.g. +4940300512877; an identity credential

email.meaning: registered contact email address, lower case; an identity credential

customer_code.format: AHL-<ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country>-<6 digits>, e.g. AHL-DE-204417
customer_code.meaning: Aurelia Hanse Line customer code printed on every invoice and booking confirmation; an identity credential

tax_registration_number.meaning: company tax or customs registration number on file (EORI, VAT, EIN or USCI), exactly as registered; an identity credential

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was opened with the line; an identity credential

customer_role.meaning: commercial role of the company: a cargo owner shipping its own goods, a freight forwarder, or a licensed non-vessel-operating common carrier

credit_status.meaning: credit standing set by the line's credit control department; cash_in_advance customers pay before release, credit_hold blocks credit terms

credit_days.meaning: approved payment term in calendar days counted from invoice date, set by credit control

ebl_platform_enrolled.meaning: whether the company is enrolled and KYC-approved on the line's electronic bill of lading platform

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the verification record, one per customer (content hash of the customer id)

customer_id.meaning: customer whose caller identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the caller passed identity verification; monotonically non-decreasing once true

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record (content hash of customer id and reason)

customer_id.meaning: customer handed to a human representative (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

contract_id.meaning: primary id of the service contract record; also quoted to customers as the contract reference

customer_id.meaning: contract holder (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: service contract tier, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contract (basis: lifecycle.states of the contract charter)

trade_lane.meaning: the single trade lane whose cargo the contract rates apply to

mqc_feu.meaning: minimum quantity commitment for the whole contract term, in FEU

rate_basis.meaning: whether the base ocean rate is fixed for the term or re-indexed quarterly against the published freight index

offer_issued_date.meaning: date the contract offer was issued to the customer for countersignature

signed_date.meaning: date the customer countersigned; empty while pending_signature

effective_date.meaning: first day the contract rates apply to cargo received

expiry_date.meaning: last day of the contract term (inclusive); moved only by a term extension

terminated_date.meaning: date the contract ended by lapse or termination; empty otherwise

lifted_feu.meaning: volume credited against the MQC so far; identically the sum of lifted_volume deltas (liftings positive, reversals negative)

shortfall_balance_usd.meaning: unpaid MQC shortfall liability; identically the sum of shortfall_liability deltas

rebate_balance_usd.meaning: accrued volume rebate not yet settled; identically the sum of volume_rebate deltas

contract_event_id.meaning: primary id of the contract ledger row

contract_id.meaning: service contract the row belongs to (foreign key -> service_contracts)

customer_id.meaning: contract holder (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the contract charter

event_date.meaning: business date the row was booked

booking_id.meaning: booking whose departure is credited or reversed (foreign key -> bookings); empty on rows not tied to one booking

feu_quantity.meaning: FEU volume moved by the row; positive for liftings and reversals alike (direction comes from the event family)

amount_usd.meaning: monetary amount of the row, always positive; for index adjustments the per-FEU change, signed (negative when the index fell)

assessment_period.format: YYYY-Qn (contract-year quarter label) or YYYY-FY for a full-term assessment
assessment_period.meaning: the assessment period a shortfall, rebate or index adjustment refers to

amendment_number.meaning: sequential number of a filed contract amendment

amendment_type.meaning: kind of amendment filed; none on non-amendment rows

reference_event_id.meaning: the original ledger row this row pays, waives, settles or reverses (foreign key -> contract_ledger); empty on original rows

waiver_reason.meaning: controlled reason for a shortfall waiver granted by trade management; none on other rows

payment_reference.meaning: bank remittance reference quoted by the customer for a payment, copied verbatim; empty on non-payment rows

request_id.meaning: primary id of the amendment or termination request

customer_id.meaning: requesting contract holder (foreign key -> customers)

contract_id.meaning: contract the request concerns (foreign key -> service_contracts)

request_type.meaning: what the customer asked to change

requested_mqc_feu.format: integer FEU; 0 when not an MQC change
requested_mqc_feu.meaning: the new minimum quantity commitment requested

requested_expiry_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty when not a term extension
requested_expiry_date.meaning: the new expiry date requested for a term extension

outcome.meaning: processing state of the request; amendments take effect only once signed_by_customer

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

booking_id.meaning: primary id of the booking record

customer_id.meaning: booking party (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: booking product tier, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the booking (basis: lifecycle.states of the booking charter)

booking_number.meaning: carrier booking number quoted on the confirmation, e.g. AHLU26HAM041872; for bookings created in a conversation it equals the booking_id

contract_id.meaning: service contract the booking is rated under (foreign key -> service_contracts); empty for spot bookings

trade_lane.meaning: trade lane of the port pair

vessel_voyage.meaning: vessel name and voyage currently allocated, e.g. AHL ELBE EXPRESS 614W; changes on a roll

equipment_type.meaning: ISO equipment type booked (DV dry, HC high cube, RF/RH reefer, OT open top, FR flat rack, TK tank)

container_count.meaning: number of containers of equipment_type on the booking

cargo_type.meaning: cargo handling category declared at booking

freight_terms.meaning: whether ocean freight is payable by the shipper at origin (prepaid) or by the consignee at destination (collect)

channel.meaning: channel through which the booking was placed

requested_date.meaning: date the booking request was received

confirmed_date.meaning: date space was confirmed; empty while requested

etd_date.meaning: scheduled departure date of the allocated vessel from the port of loading

cargo_cutoff.meaning: latest moment laden containers may gate in for the allocated vessel

si_cutoff.meaning: latest moment shipping instructions may be submitted for the allocated vessel

vgm_cutoff.meaning: latest moment the SOLAS verified gross mass may be submitted

vgm_submitted_at.meaning: moment the verified gross mass was received

cancelled_date.meaning: date the booking was cancelled or declined; empty otherwise

departed_date.meaning: actual departure date of the carrying vessel; empty until departed

charges_due_usd.meaning: outstanding booking charges; identically the sum of booking_charges account deltas (charges positive, payments, waivers and credits negative)

booking_event_id.meaning: primary id of the booking ledger row

booking_id.meaning: booking the row belongs to (foreign key -> bookings)

customer_id.meaning: booking party (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the booking charter

event_date.meaning: business date the row was booked

charge_code.meaning: tariff charge code of the row; payment, waiver, roll_notice and amendment_log on non-charge rows

amount_usd.meaning: absolute amount of the row, always positive (direction comes from the event family); 0.00 on roll notices and amendment logs

container_count.meaning: number of containers the row is computed on

equipment_type.meaning: equipment type the row is computed on

vessel_voyage.meaning: vessel voyage the row relates to; on roll rows, the voyage the cargo was rolled off

amendment_type.meaning: kind of booking amendment the row charges; none on other rows

roll_initiator.meaning: who caused a roll: the carrier (overbooking, blank sailing, omission) or the customer; none on non-roll rows

payment_reference.meaning: bank remittance reference quoted by the customer, copied verbatim; empty on non-payment rows

reference_event_id.meaning: the original charge or roll row this row waives or compensates (foreign key -> booking_charges); empty on original rows

bl_id.meaning: primary id of the bill of lading record

customer_id.meaning: documentation party that holds the record, normally the shipper or its forwarder (foreign key -> customers)

values: AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading
variant_name.meaning: transport document type, written as the official full name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the transport document (basis: lifecycle.states of the bol charter)

bl_number.meaning: transport document number printed on the document, e.g. AHLU2604417790

booking_id.meaning: booking the document covers (foreign key -> bookings)

shipper_name.meaning: shipper as printed on the document

consignee_name.meaning: consignee as printed; the literal 'TO ORDER' or 'TO ORDER OF <bank>' on negotiable documents

package_count.meaning: number of packages declared on the document

declared_cargo_value_usd.meaning: commercial invoice (CIF) value of the cargo declared to the line; basis for bank guarantee amounts

port_of_loading.meaning: port of loading printed on the document

port_of_discharge.meaning: port of discharge printed on the document

place_of_delivery.format: UN/LOCODE, 5 letters; equals port_of_discharge for port-to-port documents
place_of_delivery.meaning: final place of delivery printed on the document

draft_created_date.meaning: date the draft was generated from the shipping instructions

issued_date.meaning: date of issue printed on the document; empty until issued

released_date.meaning: date the cargo was released at destination; empty until released

bl_set_sequence.format: integer; 1 = first set issued, 2 = replacement or switch set
bl_set_sequence.meaning: which set of originals is currently in force

originals_outstanding.meaning: original documents issued and not yet surrendered to the line; identically the sum of originals_outstanding deltas

charges_due_usd.meaning: outstanding documentation charges; identically the sum of documentation_charges deltas

bol_event_id.meaning: primary id of the documentation ledger row

bl_id.meaning: transport document the row belongs to (foreign key -> bills_of_lading)

customer_id.meaning: party charged, credited or acting on the row: the documentation party, or the consignee for a release against a letter of indemnity or a destination surrender (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the bol charter

event_date.meaning: business date the row was booked

charge_code.meaning: documentation tariff code; payment, waiver or none on non-charge rows

amount_usd.meaning: absolute amount of the row, always positive; 0.00 on documentary rows

request_id.meaning: service request the row executes (foreign key -> bol_service_requests); empty when the row is not driven by a request

bl_set_sequence.format: integer; 1 = first set, 2 = replacement or switch set
bl_set_sequence.meaning: set of originals the row concerns

originals_count.meaning: number of originals issued, surrendered or declared void by the row; 0 on fee and payment rows

surrender_location.meaning: office where originals were surrendered; not_applicable on other rows

release_method.meaning: basis on which cargo was released at destination; not_applicable on other rows

payment_reference.meaning: bank remittance reference quoted by the customer, copied verbatim; empty on non-payment rows

reference_event_id.meaning: the original fee row this row waives (foreign key -> bol_ledger); empty on original rows

request_id.meaning: primary id of the documentation service request

customer_id.meaning: requesting party: the documentation party for corrections, telex releases, switch bills and reissues, or the consignee for a release against a letter of indemnity (foreign key -> customers)

bl_id.meaning: transport document the request concerns (foreign key -> bills_of_lading)

corrected_field.meaning: particular to be corrected; none for non-correction requests

requested_value.meaning: new wording or figure for the corrected particular exactly as supplied by the customer; empty for non-correction requests

bank_guarantee_amount_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no guarantee is required
bank_guarantee_amount_usd.meaning: amount of the bank guarantee backing a letter of indemnity

outcome.meaning: processing state of the request; awaiting_customer_action until the customer signs, surrenders or approves as the request requires

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

dnd_id.meaning: primary id of the per-container free-time record

customer_id.meaning: billed party for demurrage and detention (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: free-time product applied to the container, written as the official full name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the free-time record (basis: lifecycle.states of the dnd charter)

booking_id.meaning: booking the container moves under (foreign key -> bookings)

container_number.meaning: container the free time applies to

direction.meaning: whether the record covers the import leg at the port of discharge or the export leg at the port of loading

equipment_type.meaning: ISO equipment type of the container

discharge_date.meaning: date the laden import container was discharged from the vessel

full_gate_out_date.meaning: date the laden import container left the terminal

empty_return_date.meaning: date the empty import container was returned to a line depot

empty_pickup_date.meaning: date the empty export container was picked up from the depot

full_gate_in_date.meaning: date the laden export container gated into the terminal

loaded_date.meaning: date the export container was loaded on board

clock_stopped_date.format: YYYY-MM-DD; empty until the last clock stops
clock_stopped_date.meaning: date on which charges stopped accruing: the empty return date for an import record, the loading date for an export record

opened_date.meaning: date the free-time record was opened

settled_date.meaning: date the record reached settled or cancelled; empty otherwise

balance_due_usd.meaning: outstanding demurrage, detention and extension charges; identically the sum of dnd_charges deltas

dnd_event_id.meaning: primary id of the demurrage and detention ledger row; quoted to customers as the invoice reference on invoice rows

dnd_id.meaning: free-time record the row belongs to (foreign key -> dnd_free_time)

customer_id.meaning: billed party (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the dnd charter

event_date.meaning: business date of the row; the invoice date on invoice rows

charge_type.meaning: what the row charges or credits

amount_usd.meaning: absolute amount of the row, always positive (direction comes from the event family), rounded to the cent

chargeable_days.format: integer, calendar days; 0 on non-invoice rows
chargeable_days.meaning: calendar days charged beyond free time on an invoice row

period_start_date.meaning: first chargeable day covered by the invoice

period_end_date.meaning: last chargeable day covered by the invoice (the day the clock stopped)

target_variant.meaning: free-time product purchased by an extension row; not_applicable on other rows

waiver_reason.meaning: controlled reason for a waiver; carrier_caused_delay and terminal_closure are granted only by the operations department; none on other rows

payment_reference.meaning: bank remittance reference quoted by the customer, copied verbatim; empty on non-payment rows

reference_event_id.meaning: the invoice row this row waives or credits (foreign key -> dnd_ledger); empty on invoices, extension fees and payments

dispute_id.meaning: dispute a credit row resolves (foreign key -> dnd_disputes); empty on other rows
primary id of the demurrage and detention invoice dispute

customer_id.meaning: disputing billed party (foreign key -> customers)

dnd_id.meaning: free-time record whose invoice is disputed (foreign key -> dnd_free_time)

invoice_event_id.meaning: the single invoice row disputed (foreign key -> dnd_ledger)

dispute_ground.meaning: controlled ground on which the customer disputes the invoice

disputed_amount_usd.meaning: part of the invoice the customer disputes

reefer_id.meaning: primary id of the per-container reefer service record

variant_name.meaning: reefer service tier, written as the official full name

container_number.meaning: reefer container allocated; empty until allocated

plugged_in_date.meaning: date the laden reefer was first plugged in at the load terminal

delivered_date.meaning: date the laden reefer left the discharge terminal

charges_due_usd.meaning: outstanding reefer charges; identically the sum of reefer_charges deltas
